sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 96x72, 12 um pixel pitch, NETD < 55 mK; optical: 1/1.8in CMOS
features: Thermal and optical bi-spectrum network bullet camera with fire prevention and active deterrence
Thermal: uncooled VOx 96x72 detector, 12 um pixel pitch, NETD < 55 mK, 2.6 mm F1.0 lens, 25 x 18.75 field of view
Optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 1/1.8in CMOS ColorVu, 6 mm F1.0 lens, 56 x 30 field of view, 120 dB WDR
ColorVu low-light color imaging (0.0003 lux; 0 lux with light), warm-light supplement up to 30 m
Built-in white-light strobe (visual alarm) and audio warning (1 preset voice alert)

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical (Channel 1) and thermal (Channel 2) exposed as separate channels.

release_notes: Compact thermal and optical bi-spectrum network bullet camera pairing a 96x72 uncooled VOx detector (12 um, NETD < 55 mK, 2.6 mm lens) with a 4 MP ColorVu optical channel, temperature-exception fire prevention, a white-light strobe and audio warning. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.
